error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: 6-layer explicit fail-loud: (1) Endpoint layer: signature fail → event row http_status=401 + error_code=INV-META-001 INSERT + 401 return (Meta tarafı gözler). Verify handshake mismatch → 403 INV-META-002. Tenant unknown → 404 INV-META-005. (2) Hangfire job layer: MetaLeadgenIntakeJob [AutomaticRetry 3x] → Graph API transient fail retry, terminal fail event row UPDATE error_code=INV-META-003. Parse fail → INV-META-004 terminal. AccessToken fail → INV-META-006 terminal + ops alert. (3) Cross-service hop layer: Automation→Backend /api/internal/lifecycle/welcome-sent failure → structured warn log, welcome flow zaten outbound gönderdiği için silent non-critical; Zoho transition eksikliği ops dashboard'ta zoho_sync_log'ta görünmeyecek ama welcome mesajı müşteriye ulaştı (business continuity). (4) Dispatcher layer: ZohoLifecycleDispatcher.DispatchEvent existing RunAsync typed catches + zoho_sync_log failed row (INV-INT-125 transport or INV-INT-121 blueprint not configured). (5) Migration layer: DO $verify$ INV-SEED-018..020 RAISE EXCEPTION with actionable why+next-step guidance → transaction abort fail-loud. (6) Secret storage: plaintext JSONB LIW precedent — app_secret + page_access_token DB-level access-controlled, jsonl log explicit guard (DTO [JsonIgnore] yok — caller responsibility, SystemWarn log'lara token yazılmaz, unit test bu davranışı pin'ler).
